claims.claim: Reviewers note that matchmaking places newer or less experienced players against opponents who have better gear obtained through payment.

citations.review_text:
I Have Played this Game for a Few Days Solid Now and I have Enjoyed the Basic GamePlay Loop and Found it Very Addictive :
Pros:
Variety of Weapons: The game boasts a large arsenal, providing players with numerous options to choose from.
Engaging Graphics: The pixelated graphics are colorful and appealing, enhancing the overall gaming experience.
Community Features: Players can join clans, design logos, and participate in community events.

Cons:
Many players report that the game feels unbalanced, particularly due to the matchmaking system. New players often find themselves matched against more experienced opponents, which can be discouraging.

A significant concern is the reliance on in-app purchases. Players often feel pressured to spend money to acquire better gear, leading to a "pay-to-win" environment. This can diminish the enjoyment for those who prefer to play without spending extra money.

Pixel Gun 3D offers a fun and engaging multiplayer experience with a wide range of game modes and customization options. However, the balance issues and pay-to-win mechanics may deter some players. Overall, it can be enjoyable for those who appreciate its unique style and community aspects, but potential players should be aware of its limitations.

Overall i would Give this Game a Solid 3.5/5 (Mixed but Fun and Worth a Play)
Looking Forward to the Sequel ....

What is there that needs to be said that hasn't already? A lot, strap in.

I've always known this game to be Pay to Play/Pay to Win. I accepted that even when I was playing this on mobile circa 2017 or so. I never participated in that particular aspect in the game, but these days it feels like I have to, just to keep up with either bots or chuds that memorized their mom's credit card info. They have weapons I can't even begin to try and find. I work full time, and I already grinded an MMO in high school. I don't have nearly enough time to grind on this.

What anti-cheat do you people use? Whatever it is, it feels like a mixture between a screen door hanging on one hinge or a mask in 2021. Your solutions do not work.

The worst of the worst HAS to be ranked. The ranked battles are rancid with the scent of chud. Do you remember that episode of South Park where the four boys has to play WoW to defeat that greasy, overweight, balding neckbeard? Most people don't know this but that guy stopped playing WoW and started played PG3D. I say this believing that any other game mode is much better. I usually play team deathmatch when I'm not playing ranked and they can be just as bad, if not worse.

All of this to say, look at how you massacred my boy, Cubic Games. You have taken your Golden Goose, and unceremoniously took it behind the barn and shot it with your greed. This game USED to be fun. I used to have an absolute ball playing this. However, you took some of the original maps out of team deathmatch, you put some stupid nonsense in to replace them, and you expect us, the consumer, just just blindly accept this dog turd you have laid in front of us.

Fix your game, your fanbase depends on it.

I personally enjoy the game for the most part.  However too many one shot weapons are available so its a little un-fun sometimes.  They have also been milking the game for a while trying to sell as much as possible. Also I level up faster than I can upgrade things.  STOP GIVING ME XP BOOSTERS.

100% better than fortnite! It is quite p2w and its matchmaking isn't good, but try sky islands team fight and it is 100x better! In this game you can have a sniper and a minigun and a AR without constantly swapping! Snipers and AR users are equal! Really balanced (except P2W items)! If you do spend, make sure to eveluate every item you can first since sometimes they have you pay more for less and you have to look for a good deal. If you make an account and don't play for a year you get a ridiculous amount of stuff to help you! Please try this game!

Pixel gun had peaked around 2015-2018 (most would agree with this), this game is not the same game as it was about a decade ago.

After years of (95%) extremely unthoughtful updates, the game has fallen off and it's for a very simple reason, it's hack2win.

This is the first game that I would say is nearly impossible to pay2win, to have a semi decent fun time in the game you have no other option but to hack the game. to be the absolute best without paying a single dime would take you thousands of hours to play and grind, main problem being is modules, which ultimately buff your weapons tenfold. It's already hard enough to get modules (only obtainable from clans in which you need to be very active in, the other being ripoff module deals that cost a lot of gems). Obtaining modules alone isn't enough as you need to pay thousands of coins to upgrade them to the next level (capping at 10). You need to have a lot of time on your hands if you want max level modules, which isn't even worth doing as you can easily hack this game to unlock and max everything in the game. There is also gear that is only available from special events in which sometimes you have no idea when the items will be available. Some of the weapons in this game are deliberately harder to obtain because they are way better weapons than 95% of the guns in the game, ultimatum is a big example of this, which is fine I understand that, but the amount of time you need to set aside to grind for these weapons is absurd, unless you take out a loan the size of a mortgage. Don't forget the newly released overpowered weapons that will be nerfed an update later, just for them to rinse and repeat this cycle for every new update. To be good at this game you need patience, holy knowledge, and a commitment to grind a dead game. The time to grind out the stuff you need in this game is the same as growing up, graduating high school, go on your chosen career path, starting a family, see your kids grow up and be successful, …

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the matchmaking system as unfair, sometimes filling empty team slots with weak bots that the opposing team can easily farm for kills.

citations.review_text:
The game is heavily pay-to-win, and the matchmaking is poorly designed. When there aren't enough players to create balanced teams, the game fills the empty slots with bots. 

For example, if the match starts as 1v2, you'll be given a bot teammate instead of waiting for another real player. The problem is that bots are extremely weak, and the enemy team can easily farm them for kills, giving them a huge advantage and significantly lowering your chances of winning.
